scope: Read installed help JSON, create temporary partial structural graphs, validate them using the current production model, and execute separate original Ultra scenarios in the native core. No Max help importer or whole-help execution is claimed.
extraction_policy: Only nested p basic tabs are considered for fragment validation.
Boxes without an explicit research adapter are omitted and every omission and crossing edge is reported.
Retained edges keep the saved port indices; invalid ports fail production validation.
Current same-name counter is refused because its contract differs from Max.
All converted layouts use neutral coordinates; UI initialization and unlisted attributes are not preserved.
Only target-containing connected components are counted; accepted fragments can be incomplete and are never compatibility passes.
No proprietary source graph, message text, object argument text or helper script is retained in this report.

original_native_scenarios.scope: Independent multi-object scenarios exercise useful current Ultra contracts; none is an adapted or executed installed Max help graph.

cases.name: scalar-cold-trigger
cases.purpose: The right trigger outlet stores a float before the left bang recalls it; the next integer stage truncates toward zero.

cases.name: pack-unpack-cold-order
cases.purpose: A cold typed pack field survives a hot update, unpack reaches the arithmetic cold inlet before its hot inlet, and set stays silent until recall.

cases.name: route-select-branches
cases.purpose: Route strips a named selector before select matches the remaining number; matched, unmatched, second-route and default branches stay distinct.

cases.name: slider-flonum-bounds
cases.purpose: Slider raw-to-output scaling precedes flonum clamping; a silent slider set waits for bang and flonum Tab uses its second outlet.

cases.name: line-grain-completion
cases.purpose: A 20 ms explicit float ramp emits at 10 ms grains and completes once; stop cancels a later ramp before another output.

cases.name: metro-counter-bounded
cases.purpose: Exercise the current Ultra contracts: a 20 ms metro advances a modulo-three counter, select detects one, and zero stops future ticks. This is not the Max counter contract.

limitations: Structural fragment acceptance says nothing about complete Max runtime equivalence.
The whole corpus denominator remains 2103 installed help files; zero whole-help execution passes are added.
Only basic tabs are selected for graph conversion. Other tabs, dependency resolution, helper code, global send/receive and transport scheduling remain outside this adapter.
Native scenarios use a research descriptor transport and call production C++ compile_canvas/CanvasRuntime; they do not run Rust preparation, the browser, Tauri IPC, the audio device, or Max.
No new Max runtime reference or timing oracle is captured by this experiment.
